River of Peace

Verse 1
The river runs through quiet fields
And carries all our cares away

Chorus
Peace, peace, flowing peace
Rolling down to meet the sea

Verse 2
The stones are smooth, the water clear
And every morning starts anew

Chorus
Peace, peace, flowing peace
Rolling down to meet the sea

Bridge
Let it run, let it run
